name: Restart Wi-Fi
description: Turns Wi-Fi off and on again.
args: d=$(networksetup -listallhardwareports | awk '/Wi-Fi|AirPort/{getline; print $2; exit}'); [ -z "$d" ] && { echo NO_WIFI_ADAPTER; exit 0; }; networksetup -setairportpower "$d" off; sleep 2; networksetup -setairportpower "$d" on; sleep 6; networksetup -getairportnetwork "$d"

friendly.title: Wi-Fi

notes.message: This computer has no Wi-Fi adapter, or it is switched off or disabled. If it uses a network cable, run "Check my network" instead.

args: dev=$(route -n get default 2>/dev/null | awk '/interface:/{print $2}'); [ -z "$dev" ] && { echo CONN_NONE; exit 0; }; w=$(networksetup -listallhardwareports | awk '/Wi-Fi|AirPort/{getline; print $2; exit}'); if [ "$dev" = "$w" ]; then echo "CONN_WIFI $dev"; system_profiler SPAirPortDataType 2>/dev/null | awk '/Signal \/ Noise/{p=2*($4+100); if(p>100)p=100; if(p<0)p=0; printf "Signal : %d%%\n", p; exit}'; elif networksetup -listallhardwareports | grep -q "Device: $dev$"; then sp=$(ifconfig "$dev" | sed -n 's/.*media:.*(\([0-9]*\)base.*/\1/p'); if [ -n "$sp" ]; then echo "CONN_WIRED $dev LINK $sp Mbps"; else echo "CONN_WIRED $dev"; fi; else echo "CONN_OTHER $dev"; fi

description: Downloads a 25 MB test file and times it.
args: b=$(curl -s -m 120 -o /dev/null -w "%{speed_download}" "https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=25000000") || { echo SPEED_FAIL; exit 1; }; echo "$b" | awk '{printf "Download speed: %.1f Mbps\n", $1*8/1000000}'

name: Check for a backup
description: Looks for a Time Machine backup.
args: if tmutil destinationinfo 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Name"; then l=$(tmutil latestbackup 2>/dev/null | tail -1); echo "BACKUP_FOUND: Time Machine${l:+, latest $(basename "$l")}"; else echo NO_BACKUP; fi

friendly.title: Backup

notes.message: A backup is set up: $1.

name: Recent crashes and errors
description: Lists crash and panic reports from the last week.
args: p=$(find /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports -name "*.panic" -mtime -7 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "PANICS: $p"; a=$(find ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports \( -name "*.ips" -o -name "*.crash" \) -mtime -7 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "APP_CRASHES: $a"; find ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports \( -name "*.ips" -o -name "*.crash" \) -mtime -7 2>/dev/null | sed "s|.*/||" | sed "s/[-_][0-9].*//" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5

friendly.title: Crashes in the last week
friendly.ok: No crashes in the last week.
